construction.implementation_origin: New isolated reference implementation using synthetic fixtures

shared_schema.input: schema_version=1, synthetic=true, query, products[{id,title,description,documents[{id,text}]}], requirements[{id,description,terms}], optional limit (1..100, default 5), optional min_score (0..1, default 0.1)
shared_schema.validation: Shared ValidationError/require/type/finite-number checks; strict object fields, unique identifiers, nonempty terms and query, validated search handoff on producer and consumer.
shared_schema.errors: CLI prints one JSON object with status=error and exits 2 for usage, file, decoding, JSON or schema failures.

cross_stage_handoffs: Semantic search emits ranked product identifiers, bounded finite scores and document identifiers.
Review validates ranks, scores, identifiers, threshold and exact document provenance before examining only retrieved products.
Evidence and partial-evidence records retain product ID, document ID, search rank, search score, excerpt, matched terms and missing terms.

behavior.search: In-memory product text index includes title, description and documents. Default lexical query-token coverage is a transparent baseline, not learned semantic understanding. Positive scores meeting min_score are sorted by descending score then product ID and limited.
behavior.optional_embedding: run_pipeline(data, embedding=callable) accepts a batch callable receiving query followed by indexed texts. It must return equal-dimensional finite nonzero numeric lists. Validated normalized cosine similarity is clamped to [0,1]. No provider is called. Supplied callable determinism is the caller's responsibility.
behavior.review: A requirement has evidence_found only if all normalized token phrases occur in one retrieved document. Otherwise a traceable gap includes examined documents, partial evidence and a reason. Requirements are evaluated across retrieved products, not independently per product.
behavior.limitations: Term occurrence does not establish truth, handle negation, or prove compliance. Descriptions and product titles support search but are not review evidence. No certification claims.
behavior.synthetic_data: All example products, documents and requirements are explicitly synthetic.

test_outcomes.cli_result: One JSON object with status=ok, one retrieved product, one evidence_found requirement and one traceable gap.
